title: Winget, Spadafora & Schwartzberg Deploys AI Timekeeping to Its Attorneys
summary: National litigation firm achieves 86.7% adoption and captures 5–10% more billable hours through a phased, attorney-led rollout.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, October 20, 2026** — PointOne, the AI time platform for law firms, today announced that Winget, Spadafora & Schwartzberg, LLP (WSS) is deploying PointOne Time across the firm.


Following several years of evaluating AI timekeeping platforms, WSS selected PointOne to support its approach to timekeeping and help its attorneys capture more of the work they perform for clients. The firm’s decision reflects a focus on improving timekeeping through technology while preserving attorney autonomy and accommodating established workflows.


Benjamin Biard, Co-Managing Partner at WSS, led the rollout through a phased, attorney-led approach, introducing PointOne Time to small, diverse groups at a time. The initial group validated the platform’s fit with the firm’s needs, enabling a rollout built around WSS's culture as much as its technology needs


> *“I wanted to find a solution that addressed a challenge our attorneys experience every day, without adding another layer of complexity to their work,”* said Biard. *“What stood out about PointOne was its ability to capture the work happening across our existing systems while giving attorneys the flexibility to make it work for them. We’ve made timekeeping easier for our lawyers and are capturing 5 to 10% more billable hours.”*


## About Winget, Spadafora & Schwartzberg, LLP


Founded in 1993, Winget, Spadafora & Schwartzberg, LLP is a nationally recognized litigation firm with 10 offices across the US, representing insurers, financial institutions, businesses, nonprofit organizations, and professionals.


## About PointOne


PointOne is the AI time platform purpose-built for law firms. Its technology helps legal teams reduce manual administrative work while maintaining enterprise-grade security, privacy, and control. Beyond timekeeping, PointOne helps firms streamline billing workflows and unlock operational intelligence across the revenue lifecycle.
